properties.name: HSWM LLM semantic execution: literature and theoretical path
properties.description: HSWM LLM semantic execution: literature and theoretical path
properties.conceptual_delta: Use pretrained LLM semantics and in-context adaptation inside the existing role/context-conditioned disposition; formalize observational/action/revision contracts without hand-defining all meaning.

properties.name: LLM is the HSWM semantic execution engine
properties.description: LLM is the HSWM semantic execution engine

properties.name: Verbalized Machine Learning: Revisiting Machine Learning with Language Models
properties.description: Verbalized Machine Learning: Revisiting Machine Learning with Language Models
properties.reported_result: Natural-language parameters are executed by a frozen LLM and revised from predictions and labels by an LLM optimizer.
properties.assumptions: Task labels, prompts, model and context; reported numerical error and optimization variance.
properties.remaining_boundary: No general convergence or faithful internal-explanation theorem.

properties.name: Verbalized Particle Posterior: Bayesian Inference over Natural Language Hypotheses
properties.description: Verbalized Particle Posterior: Bayesian Inference over Natural Language Hypotheses
properties.reported_result: Multiple verbal hypotheses are proposed and revised by an LLM; small benchmark gains.
properties.assumptions: Externally defined label loss; fixed small benchmarks; black-box proposal density unavailable.
properties.remaining_boundary: MH drops prior/proposal ratios; SMC lacks incremental ratios. Exact posterior/invariance is not established.

properties.name: Learning POMDP World Models from Observations with Language-Model Priors
properties.description: Learning POMDP World Models from Observations with Language-Model Priors
properties.reported_result: LLM priors generate POMDP code refined using observation-action trajectories; semantic masking ablation reduces performance.
properties.assumptions: Given state/action/observation API, chosen trajectories and observation distance; MiniGrid only.
properties.remaining_boundary: Code execution is not the same realization as recurrent LLM semantic interpretation; no latent-ontology or causal-credit theorem.

properties.name: An Explanation of In-context Learning as Implicit Bayesian Inference
properties.description: An Explanation of In-context Learning as Implicit Bayesian Inference
properties.reported_result: An exact pretraining-distribution predictor asymptotically reaches prompt Bayes-optimal risk under distinguishability.
properties.assumptions: Latent HMM concepts, regularity/delimiters, KL separation overcoming distribution mismatch; asymptotic examples.
properties.remaining_boundary: Not a theorem of arbitrary pretrained LLMs, action grounding or persistent learning.

properties.name: Transformers Learn In-Context by Gradient Descent
properties.description: Transformers Learn In-Context by Gradient Descent
properties.reported_result: A linear self-attention layer has weights implementing a gradient step in linear regression.
properties.assumptions: Specified continuous regression encoding and constructed weights; empirical trained models in controlled tasks.
properties.remaining_boundary: Expressibility does not establish real-model learning, semantic identification or repeated stability.

properties.name: In-Context Learning Is Provably Bayesian Inference: A Generalization Theory for Meta-Learning
properties.description: In-Context Learning Is Provably Bayesian Inference: A Generalization Theory for Meta-Learning
properties.reported_result: Squared risk splits into Bayes Gap and Posterior Variance; uniform-attention class has a finite-sample gap bound.
properties.assumptions: Specified meta-distribution; conditionally IID examples; bounded domains, regularity/Hölder assumptions, ERM and uniform attention.
properties.remaining_boundary: Bound does not cover arbitrary softmax LLM, active or drifting histories; reported theorem not independently formalized here.

properties.name: Optimality of Universal Bayesian Sequence Prediction for General Loss and Alphabet
properties.description: Optimality of Universal Bayesian Sequence Prediction for General Loss and Alphabet
properties.reported_result: Exact mixture dominance gives prior-dependent loss/convergence bounds.
properties.assumptions: Normalized models and positive prior; convergence-to-truth requires supported truth or explicit misspecification bounds.
properties.remaining_boundary: Does not prove useful control or that an LLM interpreter implements the mixture. Report derives shared-action path inequality separately.

properties.name: Interventional Causal Representation Learning
properties.description: Interventional Causal Representation Learning
properties.reported_result: Under specified observational and hard-intervention data, the intervened latent coordinate is identified up to shift and scaling.
properties.assumptions: Full-column-rank polynomial decoder, support interior, reconstruction/noncollapse and intervention-output constraints.
properties.remaining_boundary: Not general latent graph or natural-language referent identification; diffeomorphism extension needs more interventions.

properties.name: Leveraging Large Language Models for Causal Discovery: a Constraint-based, Argumentation-driven Approach
properties.description: Leveraging Large Language Models for Causal Discovery: a Constraint-based, Argumentation-driven Approach
properties.reported_result: LLM semantic structural priors are combined with conditional-independence evidence using Causal ABA.
properties.assumptions: Causal graph/CI assumptions; elicited priors are imperfect; some metadata generated from ground-truth graph.
properties.remaining_boundary: Symbolic constraint-to-graph correspondence is not truth of LLM constraints; bad priors can hurt.

properties.name: EvoMemBench: Benchmarking Agent Memory from a Self-Evolving Perspective
properties.description: EvoMemBench: Benchmarking Agent Memory from a Self-Evolving Perspective
properties.reported_result: Long-context baselines remain strong; memory revision is harder than retention in tested systems.
properties.assumptions: Specified tasks, models, context and memory methods; not universal ranking.
properties.remaining_boundary: A memory or KG structure alone does not establish useful persistent learning.

properties.name: Reasoning with Language Model is Planning with World Model
properties.description: Reasoning with Language Model is Planning with World Model
properties.read_depth: Primary ACL paper methods and reported experiments
properties.reported_result: LLM predicts language state transitions and proposes actions in an MCTS planning construction.
properties.assumptions: Task-specific state/action/reward and planner; self-generated rollouts.
properties.remaining_boundary: No guarantee those rollouts match an external environment, nor continuous or fractal learning.

properties.description: LLM이 해석하고 실행하는 관계 의미
